MILLS, ET AL.,
ORDER
By Motion of October 15, the Office of the Solicitor petitioned
that the case be remanded to enable the Bureau of Land Management to
reconsider i t.
Therefore, pursuant to the authority delegated to the Board of
Land Appeals, 43 CFR 4.1, the decisions appealed from and prior Orders
of this Board herein are vacated, and the case remanded to the Director,
Bureau of Land Management, for further consideration and appropriate
action.
Newton Frishberg
Chief Judge
We concur:
Edward Stuebing
